value: For residential flats and single rooms the landlord may require a deposit of at most three months of rent at the start of the tenancy; it stands as security for the tenant's obligations on moving out (§ 59(1)).
note: Text read is Lov om leje, Law no. 341 of 22 March 2022 as published in Lovtidende; later amendments were not reviewed.

value: The landlord may in addition require rent prepaid for up to three months, provided the prepaid rent does not exceed the rent payable between the tenant's notice and the end of the tenancy (§ 59(3)).
note: Text read is Lov om leje, Law no. 341 of 22 March 2022 as published in Lovtidende; later amendments were not reviewed.

value: Rent may be demanded monthly in advance; for residential flats and single rooms it cannot be demanded for more than three months at a time (§ 58).
note: Text read is Lov om leje, Law no. 341 of 22 March 2022 as published in Lovtidende; later amendments were not reviewed.
